Rachel: mini-standdown: did — migrated quickstart Node samples to new auth flow; updated README snippets; fixed failing test in python sample; small doc fix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 (CI green)
Rachel: Blockers — sample-app docker image size still >1.2GB, need advice on slim base; waiting on @Alex for debloat plan.
Rachel: Today — finalize SDK release notes, cut sampleapp v0.3.1, tidy up snippets.

Alex: Saw the PR, nice. I can look at image this afternoon. Quick idea: switch to distroless + multi-stage, remove apt. LMK if you want a diff. :thumbsup:  

Jamie: FYI I pushed a tiny change to quickstart snippet to include `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var, was failing on macOS CI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/1240

Sam: I can help with release notes. Also CI flaky on sampleapp integration — logs show timeout at 30s on createSession call. Repro: `curl -X POST https://canary/sampleapp/v1/sessions -d '{...}'`

Rachel: Thanks — @Sam can you paste the failing log snippet? @DocsBot could you rerun the sampleapp canary job?

DocsBot: Scheduled rerun of sampleapp-canary on ci/run/987 — started

Sam: Log snippet:
```
ERR RequestTimeout: POST /v1/sessions 504 after 30s
    at fetch (packages/sampleapp/src/request.js:42:15)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93:5)
```

Alex: 504 likely from auth service startup race. Try bumping readiness probe for auth to 60s. I'll open a quick PR to update the k8s probe + switch to distroless base.

Jamie: small doc nit — quickstart says Node 18 but SDK supports Node 20 now. I can update that and republish the snippet.

Rachel: I'll queue release notes draft in docs/release-notes.md and ping for reviews. Need someone to approve sampleapp PR before EOD. @Jamie? :pray:

Jamie: can approve after the Node update

Alex: opening image-debloat PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/1245

DocsBot: sampleapp-canary job passed ✅ (run id 987.2)

Rachel: great — blocker cleared. Thanks team. Quick follow-up: I'll add a one-liner in the README about using `--no-cache` for docker builds in a tiny PR.

Alex: 👍

Jamie: 👍

Sam: 👍
